title: An Economic Constitution of Possibility: Producing Real Freedom, Settling Contributions, and Renewing Authority

additional_titles.title: 可能性的经济宪法: 真实自由的生产、贡献的清算与权力的续约

description: Whether a person who receives an income can actually leave, rest, care for others, create, and begin again depends on services, routes of access, maintenance, and relations of power beyond income itself. This paper takes practically actionable futures as the distributive object of an economic constitution and distinguishes four institutional entitlements, each requiring its own grounds: basic participation, contribution claims, claims on scarce resources, and governance authority. Its central principle is that participation does not require a prior contribution; contributions earn returns that can be settled; claims on scarcity bear the costs of their present use; and continuing control requires continuing authorization. The paper connects this normative argument to established formal results. Equal positive exit capacities can support different complete combinations of life conditions; even a readout covering all domains can lose the provenance needed for effective repair; two successive rounds of innovation can each pay for investment, evidence, subsistence, and maintenance; cumulative receipts attributed to one contribution source, summed over all successor slots, are bounded by its original issuance; labor saved by a public method preserves every previously legal continuation; and the replacement of public services, the inheritance of responsibilities, and arbitrary finite continuation can hold together. These results connect basic provision, a knowledge commons, joint clearing, self-directed time, polycentric governance, and ecological responsibility through a set of institutional arrangements that can be checked. The capability approach identifies what should be evaluated; this paper further asks how capabilities are produced, who pays for them, and who may determine the next rules. The technical appendices supply complete proofs, conditions, and correspondences to the original declarations. New interfaces for generative money and bounded auditing are presented as explicit designs.

additional_descriptions.description: 一个人获得收入之后，能否真正离开、休息、照护、创造和重新开始，取决于收入之外的服务、通路、维护与权力关系。本文以真实可行动的未来为经济宪法的分配对象，提出四项须分别成立的制度资格：基础参与、贡献索偿、稀缺资源请求和治理权限。其中心原则是：参与不以贡献为门槛，贡献取得可结算的回报，稀缺请求承担当次成本，持续控制取得持续授权。本文将这一规范论证接到既有形式成果上：相同的正退出容量可以对应不同的完整生活组合；全领域可达读数仍可能遗失有效修复所需的来源；连续两轮创新可以各自支付投资、取证与生活维护；同一贡献来源在全部后继槽中的累计受领受原发行量约束；公共方法的劳动节省保留全部原合法后继；公共服务的替换、责任继承和任意有限续行可以共同成立。由此，基本保障、知识公域、共同清算、自主时间、多中心治理与生态责任被连接为一组可检查的制度安排。能力论说明应评价什么，本研究进一步追问这些能力如何被生产、由谁支付，以及谁有权决定下一次规则。完整证明、适用条件和原声明对应置于技术附录；生成型货币与有界审计的新增接口作为明确设计给出。

English and Chinese manuscripts and technical supplements, plus editable source.
